description: What size well pressure tank you need: the drawdown for your pump's flow and minimum run time, the minimum total tank volume at your pressure-switch setting, and the smallest Amtrol Well-X-Trol model that delivers it. Formula: Required drawdown = pump gpm × run minutes. Acceptance factor = (cut-out − cut-in) ÷ (cut-out + 14.7). Minimum total tank volume = drawdown ÷ acceptance factor. A tank's drawdown = volume × acceptance factor (capped at its maximum acceptance factor). Run time = drawdown ÷ gpm.

cut_in_psi.description: Pressure switch cut-in; default 40; one of 20 = 20 psi, 30 = 30 psi, 40 = 40 psi, 50 = 50 psi, 60 = 60 psi

cut_out_psi.description: Pressure switch cut-out; default 60; one of 40 = 40 psi, 50 = 50 psi, 60 = 60 psi, 70 = 70 psi, 80 = 80 psi

run_minutes.description: Minimum pump run time; default 1; one of 1 = 1 minute (pumps up to 3/4 hp), 2 = 2 minutes (pumps over 3/4 hp)

name: calc_well_pressure_tank_size
title: Well Pressure Tank Size Calculator (Drawdown and Pump Run Time)
